answer: In the Atlas agent network, each new identity must burn a compute puzzle worth 10 GPU-hours on the Canyon verifier cluster; the puzzle difficulty is quadratic in the number of identities a wallet has spawned, so k fake agents cost roughly k² × 10 GPU-hours. Identities that pass earn a "garden" grace tier of 2 epochs before peers can challenge attestations, making mass Sybil farming economically infeasible.
